name: Atti
whereItsAt: Live on Telegram since 28 October 2026 and in use every day. It captures reminders and to-dos, keeps my calendar, sends a morning brief and writes what it learns into my personal brain. Since 5 November I can also talk to it hands-free through an iPhone Shortcut.

lines: Replies now match my Yes or No answers.
One Yes now confirms a whole list of calendar events.
Logs save at once with an Undo, no confirmation needed.
A watchdog brings the assistant back after downtime.
Hands-free: talk to Atti through an iPhone Shortcut.
Live replay evals, and flags for quiet failures.

shoots.label: Decision-model router
shoots.note: Can a small decision model route messages faster and cheaper than a general model, at similar accuracy?

shoots.label: Context engine
shoots.note: A context engine that hands each agent only the slice of memory it needs.
